We have developed a software framework for the development of real-time vision systems.
we have developed a software architecture that allows the development of real-time video processing applications in a modular, concurrent, and flexible manner.

In summary, our research is concerned with
the design, implementation and evaluation of a generic, modular, extensible software architecture that supports the development of real-time video processing applications.
the development of a generic software architecture to support real-time data stream processing applications.
the design of an extensible software architecture for real-time video processing, and its application to a real-time video segmentation system.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

we are proposing a novel architecture for video processing applications, that provides a generic and extensible framework to develop data-stream manipulation components, and to specify and implement data flow applications.

our architecture provides a generic and flexible software framework for real-time video processing, that allows for easy integration of new processing nodes, and for the development of complex applications.
we have shown that the proposed architecture is a viable alternative for developing video processing applications in a real-time environment.

we have developed an open source software library for video processing applications, that provides a generic, extenable, modular software architecture that can be used to develop applications for video processing, in real-time.
we have developed a modular software architecture for video processing, that is flexible, generic and extensible.
our architecture provides a generic, extensibile, and flexible framework to implement video processing applications in real-time.

the proposed architecture provides a generic and flexible solution to the development of real-time applications that process video streams.

a generic, modular architecture for data stream manipulation can support the development of a wide variety of computer vision applications, while providing the flexibility to optimize performance for specific applications.
a generic, extensibly, modular architecture can support real-time video processing applications, with a performance that can be comparable with ad hoc, specialized implementations.
